$comment: PM1 · the SAP-style process maps of ChitBridge, read FROM THE CODE (2026-10-12). One row per step: who · screen · engine function · API route · chit kind · ledger entry · test · status. A file is `repo:path` (web = this repo · api = chitbridge-api · engines = chitbridge-engines). A step the code does not have is status MISSING with the evidence, never invented. e2e/process-map.cjs checks every file (and function name) still exists; tools/gen-process-docs.cjs writes the .md files from this one.

status_words.warn: ⚠️ built, with a gap named in the note
status_words.missing: MISSING — nothing in the code does this step

steps.who: a buyer the catalogue was delivered to
steps.chit: none — a message thread on the item
steps.note: No engine function and no test: the route writes the thread itself (RLS scopes the read).

steps.who: the seller
steps.note: Nothing stores a priced offer to a named party before an order. Evidence: api lib/instruments.js names the stage ('Catalogue, quote & terms') and lib/beckn-map.js maps a Beckn quote, but no route, chit kind or screen raises one.

steps.who: the buyer (storefront, or the shop's own app)
steps.chit: order (workflow kind order_in on the seller's copy)

steps.who: the seller's staff
steps.chit: the order's lines marked delivered; status → completed
steps.ledger: none — a stock movement OUT (perpetual, weighted average)

steps.who: the seller (the counter bill IS the invoice)
the owner or a person with the books (Receive)
steps.chit: the payment is recorded on the bill
steps.ledger: payment_received · Dr 1400 Cash / 1500 Bank / 1510 UPI / 1520 Card · Cr 1300 Customers (a cheque only when cleared)

steps.who: the system (the hook after a chit; the nightly for walk-in days)
steps.ledger: sale_bill · Dr 1300 Customers (unpaid) / Dr 1400·1500·1510·1520 (paid) · Cr 4000 Sales · Cr 2200/2201/2202 Output CGST/SGST/IGST · 6900 Round off. walkin_day: the same per counter per day, no party

steps.who: the owner (reads; Finance suggests, nothing posts)
steps.chit: none — a read of the open bills, the promised dates (CRM follow-ups) and the cheques in hand behind each day
steps.ledger: none — reads the cash / bank role ledgers as at today; the first day below zero is said in words

steps.who: the seller proposes it from a sent invoice; the customer accepts, counters or declines; each run mints a normal invoice
steps.chit: subscription (the agreement, both parties hold it) → one invoice per run, client_ref rep:<agreement>:<date>
steps.ledger: each run posts as any sent invoice (lib/books-hooks afterChit); the agreement itself posts nothing
steps.note: RI1 (2026-10-12): better than a recurring invoice — the customer agrees first (accept · counter · decline), can skip a run with a reason, and pausing or ending is visible to both. Table repeat_supply (b303, DRAFT — renumbered in INT2; IM1 holds b302).

steps.who: the shop's staff
steps.chit: none yet — a supply row, or a captured message about to become a chit
steps.note: No test exercises lib/supply-store.js or routes/supplies.js by name.

steps.who: the shop (as buyer)
steps.chit: order (workflow kind order_out on the buyer's copy)

steps.who: the shop's staff (goods-in, with what the goods are FOR)
steps.chit: the supplier's bill or order, lines received
steps.ledger: none — a stock movement IN at landed cost
steps.note: T1-INV (2026-10-14): POST /api/till/stock is NOT a receipt — it switches a product available/unavailable (INV step 2).

steps.who: the supplier (delivered over CTP or captured), or the shop's counter receipt carrying their bill
steps.chit: bill (received copy, side buy) — or MY counter receipt carrying their bill no. + total (F10: Bills · Received, accepted from the Waiting list's popup; their invoice for the same order is the bill instead)
steps.ledger: purchase_bill · Dr 5000 Purchases (resale) / an asset 10xx / an expense 6xxx (by `use`) · Dr 2210/2211/2212 Input CGST/SGST/IGST · Cr 2100 Suppliers · reverse charge Cr 2204/2205/2206
steps.note: T1-INV (2026-10-14): a supply bought (POST /api/supplies/purchase) posts NOTHING to the books — it records the supply and, for a kept supply, stock IN (INV step 1).

steps.who: the owner or a person with the books (Pay)
steps.chit: the payment advice goes to the supplier as a chit (rail-advice.js → /api/chits/send)
steps.ledger: payment_made · Dr 2100 Suppliers · Cr 1400 Cash / 1500 Bank (a cheque only when cleared)

steps.who: the system (the hook after the bill is accepted)
steps.chit: bill → one entry (source_ref chit:<chit_id>); what cannot post waits in books_outbox
steps.ledger: as step 4; the supplier's statement reads 2100 by party

steps.who: the owner (reads; Pay and the discount are the owner's own presses — Finance suggests, nothing posts by itself)
steps.chit: the supplier's bill (side buy) → the payment, its advice chit (step 5)
steps.ledger: none to read; the discount (owner-pressed) is a journal: Dr 2100 Suppliers (against the bill) · Cr 4230 Discount received. The GST credit note waits for the supplier's and the owner's confirm
steps.note: F4: supplier bill → payment — what we owe, aged 0–30/31–45/46–60/60+, MSME day 45 (India, Income-tax s.43B(h)), the supplier's early-pay offer. The total is F3's outgoing (one calculation).

steps.who: the owner, after registration and before the books open
steps.ledger: none — the pack the chart, the year and the tax heads are read from
steps.note: FX-UX2 (2026-10-14): the door to this step is the register form (app/register-form.js) — app.html #/register and CB Settings › New shop (settings.html#/new, the sign-in window's New shop? Register) paint the same form; from CB Settings a verified shop lands on Home. SET1: the same step and the shop's own particulars (GSTIN · address · state · PIN — what the invoice party reads) are CB Settings (settings.html), never the workshop. CS1: the constitution (country · currency · FY · tax registration) is set once; a country with no pack is said in the server's sentence. CL1 · CL2: the Country lab shows what REGISTERING in another country would look like, read from the packs — a shop never changes country once it has a product or a transaction (DECISIONS 13 Oct). CS2 (2026-10-13): the country may be CORRECTED until the shop holds a product or a transaction (api country-setup.isConstituted) — currency · FY · scheme · time zone · chart re-derived from the new pack in one transaction; after that Country and Money are greyed with the reason and the server refuses (409). The picker = the server's countries[] (the registered packs); a multi-zone pack asks the zone, the device's preselected. FX-AU1 (2026-10-14): registration STORES the guess the panel showed (country · money · zone, the server naming its source) in the write that creates the shop; an IN→AU correction re-lays the year by its dates and the chart shows only the new pack's ledgers. CL3: both screens show "Where ChitBridge is for <country>" — per product area ✅ · ⚠️ · ❌ · —, read from public/data/country-ready.json (scripts/country-ready.cjs: the engines' COUNTRY-MATRIX × COUNTRY-COVERAGE §1). GOV-SPIN (2026-10-14): a regional spin STATES its country (api installation.country, b382); the register panel offers it first ("This ChitBridge runs in Australia", the browser's differing guess beside it), shows what its pack applies (money · year · tax · format · language), and the one reg-agree accepts it; another country only inside the constitution's allowed.countries. registerNew stores the offer, verify the accepted country + its source (signup_context.country_source, b383). e2e/walk-spin-country.cjs walks installation × browser.

steps.who: the owner (a typed entry); the system (every hook)
steps.chit: none — a voucher (series by type: SV · PV · RV · PY · CV · CN · DN · JV; a typed one MJ)
steps.ledger: the rule's lines; a manual entry must balance to the minor unit or is refused

steps.who: the counter (close); the system (the nightly folds the walk-in day)
steps.chit: none — the day's walk-in bills folded into one entry per counter per day
steps.ledger: walkin_day · Dr 1400 Cash / 1500 Bank / 1510 UPI / 1520 Card · Cr 4000 Sales per rate · Cr 2200/2201/2202 Output tax
steps.note: FX-CT1 (2026-10-14): the day report asks the server for THIS counter's day (GET /api/till/bills?till=) and compares by bill number; when they differ it says so in one line with its fix (Read the day again · Send them now) and Close the day is greyed until they agree; offline it says it could not check and does not hold the close.

steps.who: the owner
steps.ledger: none — a locked period refuses a dated entry (PERIOD_LOCKED)

steps.who: the owner
steps.ledger: set-off: Dr 2200/2201/2202 Output · Cr 2210/2211/2212 Input, in the pack's order; payment (gst_payment): Dr 2200/2201/2202 per head · Cr 1500 Bank. BAS1: the shop's own return (AU BAS · AE VAT201) is a READ of the period's ledger movements by role — nothing posted, nothing lodged
steps.note: BAS1 (2026-10-12): the return is prepared, not lodged — SBR / EmaraTax filing is an owner decision. The GST close & pay form below the return is still India-shaped (April months, four heads); an AU / AE set-off screen is a later round.

steps.who: the owner
steps.ledger: every period locked; the year's profit carried to 3900 Profit and loss (retained); the opening rows of the next year (period 0)

steps.who: the owner (reads); a CA (the handover pack)
steps.ledger: read only — Schedule III lines come from the pack beside each code

steps.who: the owner (reads; Finance suggests, nothing posts)
steps.ledger: none — the GST owed is READ after the set-off (the same arithmetic the month close posts), due on the COUNTRY PACK's own return date (IN the 20th after the month · AU the BAS quarter's 28th · AE the FTA stagger's 28th, or no date + why — W1-FIN); cash · bank · UPI · card balances as at today

steps.who: the owner (accepts · records · asks); a view-only login reads (Ask / Record greyed with the server's sentence)
steps.chit: the other party's payment advice (M30) explains a line; an unexplained one is ASKED with a message chit (business_json.kind bank_query — date · amount · ref only); their advice answers it
steps.ledger: none here — a line told by a chit but not in the books is recorded through the ONE writer (POST /payments, the pay sheet prefilled with their amount, ref and bills); the statement never leaves the device
steps.note: BR1 (2026-10-13): three-way — statement line ↔ payment chit ↔ ledger entry. Accept marks, notes and learned rules stay on the device (no server store yet).

steps.step: reports: the rail measured once on the server (chits · open · stuck · unread · closed · in dispute · ages) by window; every number opens the list that holds it
steps.who: any signed-in person of the shop
steps.note: T3-P4-ACCOUNT. One calculation: the tab paints GET /api/folders/mis and computes nothing; stuck follows the rail's rule (own notes never stuck) so a number opens CB CRM › Chits › Stuck and agrees. The workshop MIS's browser sums are not ported.

steps.who: the shop's staff (goods-in; a supply bought)
steps.chit: the received bill or order; none for a supply bought
steps.ledger: none — IN at landed cost, weighted average (perpetual); a supply bought posts nothing
steps.note: T1-INV (2026-10-14): a supply bought moves stock IN only when the supply is kept, and reaches the books only through a supplier bill (P2P step 4).

steps.who: the counter, the shop, a connected system; the shopper reads it on the storefront
steps.ledger: none — quantities only; the books value stock at step 5
steps.note: T1-INV (2026-10-14): ONE stock reader (stock-store.onHand). The storefront shows the shop's own ledger; the connector's figure only where a connector owns the shop's stock stream (policy stream_owner.stock). POST /api/till/stock(/bulk) is an availability switch (available/unavailable), never a quantity.

steps.who: the counter (a bill); staff (a supply used)
steps.chit: bill (a till bill IS the handover); none for a supply
steps.ledger: none at issue — the sale posts under O2C step 7; a supply issued posts nothing
steps.note: A supply issued leaves stock but no expense entry is raised; the cost reaches the books only through the supplier bill (P2P step 4, use).

steps.who: the shop's staff
steps.note: No route or screen takes a physical count. Evidence: api routes/integrations.js says 'returns and stock counting are version 2'; lib/stock-store.js shrinkage() reports reason-coded losses but nothing writes a count; closing stock 'automatic' (step 5) refuses a product below zero and asks for a count no screen can take yet.

steps.who: the owner (types the value, or values the stock ledger)
steps.ledger: closing_stock · Dr 1200 Stock-in-hand · Cr 5050 Changes in inventories (or the reverse) — the difference from the books, lower of cost and NRV
steps.note: T1-INV (2026-10-14): method 'automatic' values the ledger's quantities (weighted average, as at the end of the day) and is refused only when something is missing, with a code and the products named (STOCK_LEDGER_MISSING · STOCK_LEDGER_EMPTY · STOCK_BELOW_ZERO · STOCK_UNCOSTED · STOCK_UNREADABLE). The screen still offers the typed value only; the engine still takes a value (posting.js closing_stock refuses 'automatic' — engines change queued).

steps.who: the owner
the owner (sets); the person (signs in)
the person (at a counter)
steps.note: What exists is the counter sign-in, release and break state, and a work PATTERN (shift blueprints). Nothing records a day worked, hours or leave as an attendance register. PEOPLE-SRV1: the owner marks a person away / back (PUT /api/actors/break { actor_id }).

steps.who: the owner
steps.ledger: the chart has 6020 Salaries · 5100 Wages · 2420 Salary and wages payable — no rule fills them
steps.note: grep attendance|payroll|payslip|salary over api routes/, lib/ and migrations/ finds nothing outside the chart (engines src/reg-in.js). A salary can only be posted as a typed expense (class salary → 6020).

steps.who: the owner
steps.ledger: none — posting payment_made needs a creditors party; an employee is not one
steps.note: Only POST /api/books/entries (a typed, owner-only journal) can record a salary paid. No employee party, no advice, no payslip.

steps.who: the shop's staff (one by hand, or the call desk's first list from a CSV)
steps.chit: none — a party row (added_via lead) with a lead_stage membership; the import makes the same rows as a set (≤500, phone-deduped, preview = the server's dry run)

steps.who: the shop's staff (the call desk)
steps.chit: none — an interaction and the next follow-up
steps.note: W1-CRM: the call screen is the row's next level — the stage's script (CALL_SCRIPT) and Next; an outcome saved opens the row that followed.

steps.who: the shop's staff
steps.chit: none — outcome demo_booked moves the stage to demo and books the follow-up 'Demo'
steps.note: The demo itself (held, who, what was shown) has no record beyond the follow-up row.

steps.who: the shop's staff
steps.note: 'trial' is one of the lead_stage groups; no outcome moves to it and nothing starts, times or ends a trial.

steps.who: the party (by trading); the shop (adds a customer)
steps.chit: the first bill: txn_count > 0 ends the lead (isLead); a traded party refuses a stage move — counted for a bill SENT to the party (the recipient auto-add) and for a counter bill that NAMES them in business_json.customer (lib/crm.traded, inside the bill's transaction — FX-L2C)
steps.ledger: none here — the bill posts under O2C step 7

steps.who: the shop's staff note consent (the record's Consent block); the shopper says yes/no and asks for a copy or erasure on the storefront; the owner answers a request
steps.note: T3-P3-CONSENT (14 Oct): screens built — CRM record › Consent, #/privacy register, the storefront's Privacy sheet; every provider send asks lib/privacy.gate (consent-senders guard). Still warn: migrations b306 / b307 are drafts the owner runs (docs/compliance/OWNER-ACTIONS.md).

flows.name: Market to reach (T3-P2-CRM: a set of customers, their consent, one send, the shop window)
flows.sap: SD / CRM marketing (campaign) — a baseline, not a spec: our set is the one segment rule + customer_list.groups, our send asks the one gate

steps.who: the owner or an editor names a group and places customers in it
steps.chit: none — customer_list.groups[] (b205), the same value an offer's Only for stores; the four segments are SEGMENT_SQL, read

steps.who: the screen asks who may be sent offers — the server's verdict per member, by code
the owner or an editor sends to the members who agreed — the one sender per member
steps.chit: none — a channel_outbound row per member (sent · refused with the sender's reason · failed)
steps.note: Only WhatsApp is sendable, and only with WHATSAPP_TOKEN and a bound line (b123/b126); without them every member is refused in words. A set over 100 is refused before any send.

steps.who: the owner picks the showcase template; staff share the link with a party who agreed, or with a group
steps.chit: none — the policy flag showcase_template; a shared link is an OUT message on the party's timeline, gated
steps.note: The share itself leaves from the shop's own phone (wa.me); the api logs it through the gate.

steps.who: staff read a customer's points on the record (balance · worth · next · expiry · history)
steps.chit: none — the reward ledger, folded by the engine

flows.name: Client to verified (the practice door)
flows.sap: no SAP module — the incumbents (Xero HQ / QBOA / MYOB Practice, docs/research/COMPARE-AU-BOOKS-2026-10.md §2) are a baseline only; built on our construct (docs/design/practice-door/REQUIREMENT.md §0)

steps.who: the CA firm (registers as an entity of kind practice)
steps.note: No entity kind 'practice': api lib/entitykind.js declares supplier · network · actor · shopper · internal · test only; POST /api/entities/register (routes/entities.js) mints a shop. The practice page (web:public/practice.html) does not exist; its module row joins modules[] when it does (round CA3).

steps.who: the practice (by the client's handle) or the client owner (by the practice's handle) sends a request
steps.note: Nothing lets one entity ask another for access: a connection is a status with no scope (api db/schema.sql connections; migrations/net01_network.sql cb_edge) and the only trace is the empty-state words 'Invite an accountant' in api lib/sides.js. Planned: practice_grant row status=sent, no expiry (a To-do row until answered); migration FILE next free bNNN (b299 is taken), round CA2.

steps.who: the client OWNER accepts (picks the level: viewer · commenter · editor) or rejects — the rail's own verbs
steps.note: No cross-business permission model (web docs/DESIGN-NOTES-2026-10.md §1.2 item 2): one actor row = one shop (api migrations/b173_access_level.sql), whole_entity is entity-scoped by design. The three levels and their ladder EXIST (api lib/access.js levelOf, engines src/rail.js byLevel) and the verbs are the rail's (engines src/rail.js ACTIONS accept · reject); what is missing is the edge that carries a level between two entities (states sent · accepted · rejected · ended) and its event log (the access-events.js shape).

steps.who: the practice owner and staff (read): Client · Sealed to · Nightly says
steps.note: No cross-client read: api lib/books-nightly.js check() stores books_setting.last_check per shop (problems[], at); lib/books-pack.js build chains each pack (sha256, prev_sha256) and POST /api/books/packs/:id/ack stores acknowledged_at; lib/books-todo.js todo() lists one shop's to-do — but nothing lists them across the shops a practice holds (RLS is per entity; the one cross-shop read is ops.f_books_enabled, ids only) and no stored word says which month is sealed (locked + pack built + chain ok + acknowledged). web public/app/cap-network.js is commerce-only, no finance figures. Planned: last_check.summary + ops.f_practice_clients + GET /api/practice/clients (CA2), practice.html S1 (CA3).

steps.who: a practice person (one click into the client's Ledger — reads a sealed record, nothing copied out)
steps.note: One token = one shop (api middleware/auth.js entityOf); a person session (lib/person-session.js) is minted for the person's own shop only. Nothing mints a client-scoped session from a grant, and nothing records an open of the books by name (access_events records access CHANGES only). Planned: POST /api/practice/clients/:id/open + practice_open rows (CA2).

steps.who: a practice person asks ON THE CHIT: a commenter the client's team (internal thread), an editor also the client's supplier (external thread); each answers in its own login
steps.chit: a message on the client's chit (msg_type query, exists), internal or external thread
steps.note: The ONE composer (CBThread), the ladder (a commenter posts internally, an editor externally, a viewer reads and sees the sentence) and msg_type 'query' (migrations/000_baseline_part2.sql CHECK) exist and are reused as they are. No due date and no answered flag: the thread's last message says whose turn it is (REQUIREMENT §9). Missing: the anchor for a MONTH's question (the month's pack as a message subject beside chit_id — owner Q1, decided before CA2) and the cross-client count threads_waiting_on_client in last_check.summary.

steps.who: the client owner (any time) or the practice (ends the engagement; from sent = withdraws)
steps.note: Nothing to end yet (step 3). The mechanism it will use exists: a person session is as alive as its listing and an end is refused everywhere within 60 s (api lib/person-session.js CACHE_MS); the ledger is insert-only, so what the practice posted stays, stamped by the person (app.current_actor).

steps.who: the owner, or the practice that keeps the books
steps.ledger: a ledger per account under its group (the system's code; theirs kept as source_code, b302); a control account merges onto the role ledger
steps.note: The columns are the export's recall (IM0), guessed and confirmed, never assumed. source_code needs migration b302 (a file); before it the trial balance matches on names.

steps.who: the owner, or the practice
steps.ledger: none — a party on the customer / supplier list (party_no from the one series; ABN as a party_tax_id)
steps.note: Dedupe: ABN, then phone (as L3's lead import), then name. A bad ABN is skipped with reg-au's sentence. Writes per party go through party-fields.patch (the one writer).

steps.who: the owner, or the practice
steps.ledger: none — a product with price and gst_rate (their tax code → the pack's supply kind → the rate)
steps.note: A code already in the catalogue is skipped (a move-in never overwrites prices). Stock on hand is not read in phase 1.

steps.who: the owner, or the practice
steps.ledger: ONE opening entry (period 0) per file: the trial balance (the customers / suppliers control rows left out), then the open invoices and bills bill-wise on 1300 / 2100 with party, bill and due date; the difference on Suspense 2900
steps.note: An unbalanced trial balance is refused with the sentence; nothing posts. The same file twice posts nothing (client_ref movein:<kind>:<as_at>).

flows.name: Parallel run (their Tally / Xero period beside ours)
flows.sap: FI (audit: parallel run, reconciliation of statements)

steps.who: the owner, or the shop's auditor (whole entity, may see money)
steps.note: Insert-only: a part a snapshot already has is refused (409). Before b309 runs, Load is greyed with the sentence.

steps.who: the owner, or the shop's auditor
steps.chit: read (the chit behind an entry opens)
steps.note: Why is said where we can tell: a rounding rule, a bill on the rail they keyed later, an entry only one side has, a mapping gap. Tally XML shapes are recall, proven on fixtures.

steps.who: the owner, or the shop's auditor
steps.note: CSV from the server; the PDF is the browser's print of the page (no PDF library added).

flows.name: Foreign currency (a bill in another currency, its settlement, the period-end revaluation)
flows.sap: FI (foreign currency valuation · realised / unrealised exchange differences)

steps.who: the owner (anyone who reads the books sees the rates)
steps.note: Never fetched, never assumed. Before b391 runs, Add rate is greyed with the sentence.

steps.step: a foreign bill posts at its day's rate; its payment settles with the exchange gain or loss
steps.who: the hooks (a chit) · the owner (a payment)
steps.chit: read (the bill or invoice chit, in its own currency)
steps.ledger: the bill at its day's rate; the payment Dr money at its rate · Cr the party at what the books carry · the difference on 4260 Exchange gain or loss
steps.note: No rate for the day → waits on Waiting, named: No USD rate for 14 Oct — add it in Accounts › Rates.

steps.step: revalue at the month end, reversed next month
steps.who: the owner, from Month lock
steps.ledger: two entries in one transaction: the unrealised difference on 4260 at the month end, its reversal on the next month's first day
steps.note: Debtors and creditors only; a currency with no closing rate is named and nothing is revalued.

flows.name: Dispute to settled (the USP: per-party, confidential)

steps.who: a party on the chit (an editor of the shop)
steps.chit: the chit itself — a dispute copy per party on the roster (chit_disputes, per-copy RLS)
steps.ledger: none (a supplier bill under an open dispute waits — books-hooks buyerGate)
steps.note: Raise is shown always, greyed with the rail's sentence (actions.raise); who it may name is the server's (raise_parties).

steps.who: the shop: what it raised, what is against it
steps.chit: read (the chit sheet opens the chit; the dispute's room is its own thread)
steps.note: Server-paged (status · side · q · sort · page); the room is CBThread scoped to the dispute's roster.

steps.who: the business that raised it — per party or all
steps.chit: the dispute copies close per party; the raiser's when none is left open
steps.ledger: a bill held by the dispute is released (books-hooks afterChit)
steps.note: Resolve is not a rail action yet: its rule is composed in api lib/dispute-may (engines change queued: rail ACTIONS + resolve_dispute).

steps.who: the help desk; CB Assist proposes
steps.note: A draft is never stored: Accept publishes it, Reject throws it away (the old gap queue is retired: /assist/gaps · /assist/resolve).

steps.who: the help desk (others see it greyed, with why)
steps.note: Publish is shown always, greyed with the server's sentence (whoami actions.publish).

steps.step: counters and keys: add, open on this PC, release; make and revoke a key
steps.who: the owner (every counters write: lib/owner.gate) · any signed-in person reads
steps.note: A co-assist sees every action greyed with the server's sentence (may.manage, code OWNER_ONLY).

steps.step: connectors: download the kit, say which ones you use, approve the PC
steps.who: the owner
steps.note: A connector the shop's country pack does not offer stays listed, its Download greyed with the pack's sentence (CX6).

steps.step: rules: set a policy flag, who may change each said by the server
steps.who: the owner · a co-assist where the server allows
steps.note: The labels are POLICY_FLAGS (one list, cap-settings.js); lib/policy FLAGS is the whitelist and the may/why.

steps.step: plan and usage: the plan, each quota as a state, what was billed
steps.who: the owner
steps.note: Reporting only: no route gates on plan (enforced:false) and every sellable tier's quotas are not decided — shown as 'Not decided yet', never as unlimited.

steps.step: account: where you are signed in (sign one out), every device (the owner removes one), keys (a door to the one list), the vault
steps.who: any signed-in person (own sessions · the vault); the owner (every device, remove) — may.devices from the server
steps.note: T3-P4-ACCOUNT. The current session's Sign out is greyed (the server's `current`, a field); a co-assist sees Every device greyed with may.devices (code OWNER_ONLY). API keys stay ONE list under Counters & keys. SET-WALK1 (2026-10-15): the vault PUT is a MERGE-PATCH with a version (W25: lib/vault-patch over the keyed view; 409 VAULT_CHANGED 'Changed since you opened it — reload?'); an empty list is as tall as its content (W21, list-ctl fit); a legacy sign-in still lists this device (W18); the section picker's choice is what is added, with the section's standard rows first per country (W22/W23).
